title: I got tired of making the same trading mistakes, so I built something to help
author: TradeCoach_
selftext:
I kept repeating the same mistakes in my trades, so I built TradeCoach. 📈

It’s an AI trading journal that helps you review your trades, spot bad habits like FOMO or chasing, and improve your execution over time. 🧠

It’s not a signal service or a stock picker, just a tool for traders who want to get more disciplined. 🔎

Curious if anyone else tracks their trades like this?

comments.author: DramaticPresent1040
comments.body: You selling or is for yourself?

replies.author: TradeCoach_
replies.body:
I originally built this tool for myself to improve my own trading. As I used it consistently, I noticed my trading strategy became more disciplined and my overall understanding of the markets improved significantly. 

Seeing the impact it had on my own decision-making made me realize it could help others as well. That’s when I decided to build TradeCoach, a system designed to give everyday traders access to the same structured guidance that helped me become a better trader.
